commands.name: /换背景
commands.template: Keep the character and pose in <image1> unchanged. Replace the background with {target}. Preserve the original facial identity, hair, body shape and pose.

commands.name: /去水印
commands.template: Remove all watermarks, logos, and subtitles from the image. Keep all other content unchanged.

commands.name: /去物体
commands.template: Remove the {object} from <image1>. Fill the removed area naturally to match the surrounding context. Keep all other content unchanged.

commands.name: /扩图
commands.template: Extend the canvas to {width}x{height}. Fill the extended area with content consistent with <image1>.
